description: This source file implements a class 'VertexFineTuningAPI' that extends 'VertexLLM' to facilitate fine-tuning language models using Google Cloud Vertex AI. It includes methods to convert request and response formats between OpenAI and Vertex, create fine-tuning jobs synchronously and asynchronously, and pass through POST requests to Vertex AI endpoints.

classes.name: VertexFineTuningAPI
classes.description: A class that provides methods for managing fine-tuning jobs on Google Cloud Vertex AI, including conversion between formats, creating jobs asynchronously and synchronously, and passing requests through the Vertex AI API.

methods.description: Converts OpenAI hyperparameters into Vertex-specific hyperparameters.

methods.description: Converts Vertex AI fine-tuning job response into a format compatible with OpenAI's API.
